_meta.description: Federal AI transparency and governance public-record tracker. Entries summarize official federal sources only.
_meta.scopeNote: Planning and reference aid only. Entries identify federal AI executive orders, policy memoranda, and official plans relevant to federal AI governance. They do not determine legal applicability, compliance status, or preemption effect.

records.title: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: Revokes prior AI directives identified as barriers to AI innovation and directs development of an AI Action Plan for United States AI leadership.

records.title: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust
records.summary: Provides federal agency guidance for AI use, governance, risk management, and public trust following Executive Order 14179.

records.title: America's AI Action Plan
records.citation: The White House, America's AI Action Plan, July 2025
records.summary: Federal policy plan issued under Executive Order 14179, focused on AI leadership, infrastructure, innovation, and security priorities.

records.title: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: Directs federal review and action toward a national AI policy framework and is the main federal-state AI governance context note used by the State AI Transparency view.

records.title: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
records.citation: The White House, Presidential Action, June 2026
records.summary: Directs coordinated federal attention to advanced AI innovation and national-security considerations across executive departments and agencies.

records.title: Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: Prior federal AI executive order retained for lineage context because Executive Order 14179 revoked it.
